about_the_game:
**Command your clicks. Control your workflow.**

Multi Clicker is a fast, lightweight auto-clicking utility designed for gamers, testers, and anyone tired of tapping.

🖱️ **Key Features:**

- Add up to **20 unique click positions**

- Set click speed from **1–20 clicks/sec**

- Toggle automation in real time with keyboard hotkeys

- Built-in help window with all controls

- No installation, no clutter — just precision automation

Built for speed. Tuned for simplicity.

Whether you're grinding idle games, testing UI elements, or just looking to save your wrists — Multi Clicker is your go-to desktop companion.

⚠️ **Performance Notice**

While Multi Clicker supports up to 20 simultaneous clickers running at up to 20 clicks per second each, some lower-spec or older machines may not be able to maintain this maximum output consistently. Performance depends on your system's processing speed, background load, and screen resolution. For optimal results, scale usage based on your hardware limits.

Note: High CPS across many clickers may exceed system limits on some machines.

⚠️ **Disclaimer**

Multi Clicker is a general-purpose automation tool designed for personal and utility use. Use of auto-clicking software **may violate the terms of service (TOS) of some games or applications.** It is the user's responsibility to ensure they are complying with the rules of any software they interact with using this tool.

The developer of Multi Clicker is not responsible for any account bans, restrictions, or penalties resulting from misuse.
